title: Migration Safety Configuration
description: Configuration file that defines which databases are allowed for automated migrations

main.name: MAIN Production Database
main.description: Primary production database. Migrations must be applied manually via Supabase Dashboard.
restrictions: All changes must be tested on STAGING first
Manual application via Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor only
Requires approval from senior developer or DBA

staging.name: STAGING Database
staging.description: Staging database for testing. All migrations should be tested here first.

preMigrationChecks: Ensure STAGING database is being used
Block if MAIN database is detected
Scan migration files for forbidden references
Check all .env files for correct configuration
preCommitChecks: Scan staged files for database references
Block commits containing MAIN database URL
Verify migration files use STAGING database

responsibilities: Coordinate with DBA for MAIN changes

bypassSafety.warning: Only use in genuine emergencies with proper authorization

steps: Apply to MAIN via Dashboard if necessary

documentation.testingGuidelines: All migrations must be tested on STAGING with real-world data scenarios
documentation.approvalProcess: MAIN migrations require documented approval from DBA or senior developer
